title: Give yourself where love can be trained
summary: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve. Offer the withheld self where Naam can be planted.
takeaway: Offer the withheld self where Naam can be planted.
lifeApplication: When fear or doubt negotiates, give the withheld part to the Guru instead of protecting it from surrender.

source.shortMeaning: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve.
source.lifeApplication: When fear and doubt tighten, offer the withheld part instead of defending it.
